"""Validation test-suite (development tool)."""
import copy, json, os, subprocess, sys

BASE = {
    "version": 3,
    "cases": [{
        "model": "cnn",
        "class_values": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7],
        "stats": [1, 1, 75],
        "bucket": [1, 1],
        "slots": [[0, 1, 0]],
        "flows": [[1, 1, -1, 2]],
        "groups": [],
        "windows": [[0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1, [[0, 0]] * 9]],
    }],
}


def run(raw):
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH'] = '/workspace/native'
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       input=raw, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, timeout=60)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode(), p.stderr.decode()


def expect_invalid(raw, label):
    code, out, err = run(raw)
    ok = (code == 0 and out.strip() == '{"error":"invalid"}')
    if not ok:
        print('FAIL (expected invalid): %s -> code=%s out=%r err=%r' % (label, code, out[:200], err[:300]))
    return ok


def expect_valid(raw, label):
    code, out, err = run(raw)
    ok = (code == 0 and '"error"' not in out and '"version":3' in out.replace(' ', ''))
    if not ok:
        print('FAIL (expected valid): %s -> code=%s out=%r err=%r' % (label, code, out[:300], err[:500]))
    return ok


def main():
    good = 0
    total = 0
    def check(raw, label, valid):
        nonlocal good, total
        total += 1
        if valid:
            good += expect_valid(raw, label)
        else:
            good += expect_invalid(raw, label)

    def mutate(fn):
        case = copy.deepcopy(BASE)
        fn(case)
        return json.dumps(case).encode()

    check(json.dumps(BASE).encode(), 'base', True)
    check(json.dumps({"version": 3, "cases": []}).encode(), 'empty cases', True)
    check(b'[', 'bad json', False)
    check(b'', 'empty input', False)
    check(b'{"version":3,"version":3,"cases":[]}', 'dup key', False)
    check(b'{"version":3,"cases":[]} trailing', 'trailing', False)
    check(b'{"version":3,"cases":[]} {"version":3}', 'two objects', False)
    check(b'\xff\xfe{"version":3}', 'bad utf8', False)
    check(b'{"version":2,"cases":[]}', 'version 2', False)
    check(b'{"version":3.0,"cases":[]}', 'version float', False)
    check(b'{"version":true,"cases":[]}', 'version bool', False)
    check(b'{"cases":[]}', 'missing version', False)
    check(b'{"version":3}', 'missing cases', False)
    check(b'{"version":3,"cases":[],"extra":1}', 'extra top key', False)
    check(b'{"version":3,"cases":{}}', 'cases not list', False)
    check(b'{"version":3,"cases":null}', 'cases null', False)
    check(b'{"version":3,"cases":[null]}', 'case null', False)
    check(b'{"version":3,"cases":[{"model":"cnn","class_values":[1,2,3,4,5,6,7],"stats":[1,1,75],"bucket":[1,1],"slots":[[0,1,0]],"flows":[[1,1,-1,2]],"groups":[],"windows":[],"x":1}]}', 'extra case key', False)
    check(b'{"version":3,"cases":[{"model":"cnn","class_values":[1,2,3,4,5,6,7],"stats":[1,1,75],"bucket":[1,1],"slots":[[0,1,0]],"flows":[[1,1,-1,2]],"groups":[]}]}', 'missing windows', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('model', 'mlp')), 'bad model', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('model', 3)), 'model int', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('class_values', [1,2,3,4,5,6])), 'class values short', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('class_values', [1,2,3,4,5,6,0])), 'class value 0', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('class_values', [1,2,3,4,5,6,1001])), 'class value 1001', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('class_values', [1,2,3,4,5,6,7.0])), 'class value float', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('class_values', [1,2,3,4,5,6,True])), 'class value bool', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('stats', [0,1,75])), 'stats zero', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('stats', [1,1,10**9+1])), 'stats too big', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('bucket', [0,0])), 'bucket zero', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('bucket', [1,2])), 'bucket initial>cap', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('bucket', [513,0])), 'bucket too big', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('slots', [])), 'no slots', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('slots', [[0,1,1]])), 'first refill nonzero', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('slots', [[5,1,0],[5,1,0]])), 'times not increasing', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('slots', [[5,1,0],[4,1,0]])), 'times decreasing', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('slots', [[0,513,0]])), 'slot cap too big', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('slots', [[0,1,513]])), 'slot refill too big', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('flows', [])), 'no flows', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('flows', [[1,0,-1,2]])), 'ceiling below target', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('flows', [[65,65,-1,2]])), 'target too big', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('flows', [[1,513,-1,2]])), 'ceiling too big', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('flows', [[1,1,0,2]])), 'group index missing', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('flows', [[1,1,-1,7]])), 'label 7', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('groups', [[0,10]])), 'group self cycle', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('groups', [[1,10],[0,10]])), 'group cycle', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('groups', [[-1,513]])), 'group ceiling too big', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0]['windows'][0].__setitem__(0, 1)), 'window flow index', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0]['windows'][0].__setitem__(1, 5)), 'window ready', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0]['windows'][0].__setitem__(2, 0)), 'expires before ready', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0]['windows'][0].__setitem__(3, 0)), 'T zero', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0]['windows'][0].__setitem__(3, 65536)), 'T too big', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0]['windows'][0].__setitem__(4, 0)), 'C zero', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0]['windows'][0].__setitem__(4, 321)), 'C too big', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0]['windows'][0].__setitem__(5, 65536)), 'draw too big', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0]['windows'][0].__setitem__(6, 0)), 'priority zero', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0]['windows'][0].__setitem__(6, 1001)), 'priority too big', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0]['windows'][0].__setitem__(7, [[0,0]]*8)), 'features 8', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0]['windows'][0].__setitem__(7, [[0,0]]*9+[[0]])), 'feature row size', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0]['windows'][0][7].__setitem__(0, [1501,0])), 'length too big', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0]['windows'][0][7].__setitem__(0, [0,2561])), 'ipd too big', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c['cases'][0].__setitem__('windows', [[0,0,0,1,1,0,1,[[0,0]]*9]]*513)), 'too many windows', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c.__setitem__('cases', [copy.deepcopy(c['cases'][0])]*9)), 'too many cases', False)
    check(mutate(lambda c: c.__setitem__('cases', [copy.deepcopy(c['cases'][0])]*8)), '8 cases', True)
    # nonfinite
    check(b'{"version":3,"cases":[],"x":NaN}'.replace(b',"x":NaN', b''), 'nan removed', True)
    check(b'{"version":3,"cases":[NaN]}', 'nan case', False)
    check(b'{"version":3,"cases":[]}', 'plain', True)
    # deep nesting
    deep = b'{"version":3,"cases":[],"d":' + b'['*200 + b']'*200 + b'}'
    check(deep, 'deep nesting', False)
    # 16MiB limit
    huge = b'{"version":3,"cases":[],"pad":"' + b'a'*(16*1024*1024) + b'"}'
    check(huge, 'too large', False)
    print('%d/%d validation checks passed' % (good, total))
    return 0 if good == total else 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
PYEOF
